board.note: 12-city network. Blue = northern, yellow = southern. Players start in Atlanta (CDC).

player_deck.note: City cards and epidemic cards. Draw 2 per turn. Game lost if empty when drawing.

infection_deck.note: Infection cards drawn at end of turn. Each names a city to infect.

infection_discard.note: Discarded infection cards. Shuffled back on top during epidemics.

hand.note: Player hand. Max 7 cards; must discard down at end of draw phase.

cures.note: Discovered cures. Contains cure marker components for each cured disease color.

infection_rate_counter.note: Infection rate index. Values 0-6 map to draw counts [2,2,2,3,3,4,4].

pawn.note: Player pawn on the city graph.

disease_cube.note: 24 per color. Placed on cities during infection. Max 3 per city per color; 4th triggers outbreak.

city_card.note: One card per city. Used for direct flight or to discover a cure (5 same-color cards).

epidemic_card.note: Shuffled into player deck. Increases infection rate, infects bottom city at 3 cubes, reshuffles infection discard on top.

infection_card.note: One per city. Drawn to determine which cities get disease cubes.

cure_marker.note: One per disease color (blue, yellow). Placed in cures zone when discovered.

phases.name: actions
phases.note: Choose 4 actions: move, direct_flight, treat, share_knowledge, discover_cure.

phases.name: draw
phases.note: Draw 2 cards from player deck. Resolve epidemics immediately. Discard down to 7.

phases.name: infect
phases.note: Draw infection cards equal to current infection rate. Place 1 disease cube on each named city.

move.constraint: destination is adjacent to current city
move.note: Drive/ferry: move pawn to a connected city.

direct_flight.note: Discard a city card to fly directly to that city.

treat.constraint: city has at least 1 disease cube of chosen color
treat.note: Remove 1 disease cube from current city. If disease is cured, remove all cubes of that color.

share_knowledge.note: Give or take the city card matching the city both players are in.

requires: player at any research station city
5 city cards of same color in hand
discover_cure.note: Discard 5 same-color city cards to discover a cure for that color. Simplified: Atlanta is the only research station.

infection.effect: place 1 disease cube of city color on named city
infection.note: If city already has 3 cubes of that color, outbreak occurs instead.

outbreak.effect: increment outbreak counter; spread 1 cube of same color to each adjacent city
outbreak.note: Chain outbreaks possible. Each city outbreaks at most once per chain.

epidemic.trigger: epidemic card drawn from player deck
epidemic.effect: increase infection rate; infect bottom card of infection deck at 3 cubes; shuffle infection discard on top of infection deck
